business_problem: Mattress Firm wanted to improve frontline productivity, sales conversations, and job satisfaction for Sleep Experts, but first had to define the right features, prove the business case, and build the technical infrastructure for a reliable generative AI assistant.
solution_summary: Mattress Firm worked with Bain and Google Cloud to build SleepExpert.AI as a production assistant for frontline retail staff. In 12 weeks the team launched a conversational system that combines chat and voice access with a large knowledge base and realistic role-play training. Drill Mode uses more than 2,000 synthetic personas to simulate customer conversations, while the agentic AI Drill Builder lets the retail training team create and edit scenarios quickly instead of managing them manually. Chat Mode answers questions about products, promotions, store operations, and technology issues so Sleep Experts do not need to rely on help-desk calls or memory alone. The deployment also added governance mechanics such as beta-user testing, a product backlog, a Knowledge Council, and KPI tracking. The source does not spell out a storage topology, but it does make clear that Google Cloud provides the generative AI and cloud-storage foundation for the assistant.

solution_components.name: SleepExpert.AI
solution_components.role: Acts as the main conversational assistant for training and on-demand support for store associates.

solution_components.name: Drill Mode
solution_components.role: Simulates customer interactions so Sleep Experts can practice sales and service scenarios repeatedly.

solution_components.name: agentic AI Drill Builder
solution_components.role: Lets the retail learning team create, edit, and manage training scenarios much faster than manual methods.

solution_components.name: Chat Mode
solution_components.role: Returns real-time answers about products, promotions, operations, and troubleshooting during store work.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI and cloud storage infrastructure supporting SleepExpert.AI.

data_flow: Product, promotion, operations, and troubleshooting knowledge flows into SleepExpert.AI on Google Cloud. Sleep Experts interact through chat or voice, Chat Mode returns answers from the knowledge base, and Drill Mode plus the agentic AI Drill Builder generate synthetic training sessions that the retail learning team can update continuously.
business_outcome: Mattress Firm reduced the time to launch an MVP, gave frontline teams faster access to answers and training, lowered reliance on help-desk calls, and scaled the assistant from a pilot group to thousands of employees across its US store network.
metrics: Rolled out to over 6,000 employees across 2,300 US stores
architecture_clues: Google Cloud provides both the generative AI and cloud storage infrastructure.
The rollout added beta-user tests, a product backlog, and a Knowledge Council for ongoing updates.
KPI tracking includes NPS, sales productivity, and conversion rates.
